## Completed work

`solution.py` (executed, run log in `run_log.txt`) fitted the agreed model
`obs_0(t) = b1·sin(2πt/P_A) + b2·cos(2πt/P_A) + c1·sin(2πt/P_B) + c2·cos(2πt/P_B) + c3·sin(4πt/P_B) + c4·cos(4πt/P_B) + offset`
by weighted linear least squares (weights 1/obs_0_err, reference_epoch_day = 0.0), with a global 2-D coarse grid (P ∈ [1.5, 600] d, 300×300), multi-start nested refinement of the top 25 distinct coarse candidates (dedup requires BOTH coordinates within 3% — this fixed a case_000 local-minimum trap), Nelder-Mead polish bounded to the scan range, and profile-Δχ²=1 period uncertainties. Both `signal_summary.csv` (4 rows, exact column order) and `target_predictions.csv` (38 rows, input order, copied `case_id`/`time_day`, component-A-only values) were written and passed an automated contract check (headers, row counts, finite scalars, case/time fidelity, prediction↔summary consistency).

### Final per-case results (obs_0)

| case | P_A (d) | P_B (d) | red χ² | A amp (SNR) | Δχ²(A) | present |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| case_000 | 25.24344 ± 0.216 | 26.49565 ± 0.012 | 0.939 | 5.425 ± 0.286 (19.0) | 192.4 | 1 |
| case_001 | 12.38976 ± 0.036 | 25.85224 ± 0.013 | 0.861 | 3.737 ± 0.211 (17.7) | 290.1 | 1 |
| case_002 | 18.45392 ± 0.147 | 26.02238 ± 0.0007 | 0.953 | 1.236 ± 0.397 (3.11) | 9.81 | 1 |
| case_003 | 10.53904 ± 0.051 | 20.41787 ± 0.011 | 1.015 | 2.419 ± 0.220 (11.0) | 105.2 | 1 |

Fitted u0 coefficients (case_000): a_basis1=2.21239, a_basis2=−4.95375, b_basis1=8.56638, b_basis2=−3.29379, b_basis3=−7.99587, b_basis4=−0.24818, offset=−2.53944; case_001: 3.14281, −2.02108, −9.83184, 2.91020, −7.84746, −6.24525, −0.24066; case_002: 1.17695, −0.37649, 0.54390, −10.46594, −6.41128, −1.99210, −2.36352; case_003: 0.92008, 2.23717, 10.64015, 0.29959, 9.03343, 2.83228, −2.86894. (Raw weighted-LS values at t=0 — no rounding or phase shift.)

### Borderline case_002 (transparency as requested)
- Refined Δχ²(B-only→joint) = **9.81** (B-only χ²=66.06 at P_B=26.017, joint χ²=56.24), 2 extra linear parameters.
- A amplitude = **1.236 ± 0.397** (SNR = **3.11**); both pre-declared criteria pass (≥4.6, ≥3σ) → `component_a_present=1`.
- Supporting jackknife (drop 1 of 4 sampling clusters, fixed periods): A amplitudes 0.83/1.34/1.63/1.28, phases −26°/−13°/−20°/−10°, phase-consistency resultant **R=0.994** (random ≈ 0.5) — the weak component is coherent across independent subsamples, not a noise artifact.
- Caveat: a window-alias minimum exists at P_A≈14.153 with Δχ²=1.4 higher (cluster gaps ~45–85 d create ~1/65 d alias spacing); the global minimum at 18.454 is retained, and the look-elsewhere-corrected significance of the detection is marginal — this is the least certain row of the summary.

### Validation
- Reduced χ² 0.86–1.02 in all cases → model complete, quoted errors trustworthy.
- Residual weighted Lomb-Scargle (40k frequencies, 1/600–0.5 c/d): highest peak only 1.3–2.2× the 90th-percentile floor — no strong leftover periodicity.
- A/B fundamental coefficient correlations at the optimum are modest (|ρ| ≤ 0.54), so the A/B split is identifiable despite P_A ≈ P_B in cases 000/002.
- Prediction 1σ bands (coefficient covariance + period-error propagation) at the farthest target: case_000 ±3.13, case_001 ±2.62, case_002 ±1.53, case_003 ±2.73 u0 — dominated by period uncertainty in the ~20-period extrapolation.
- Cross-check (non-blocking): obs_1/obs_2 fitted independently contain related but not identical structure (red χ² 1.9–3.1 under the same model; e.g. case_000 obs_2 shows P_B≈26.48 and an extra ~30.8-d component), so they were not used in any deliverable.

### Limitations
- Periods/presence are inferred, not given (input_0.json carries no such fields); `component_a_period_day` etc. are best-fit estimates.
- case_002's flag is statistically borderline (SNR 3.11); a stricter 3.5σ-style rule would have zeroed it.
- Long-horizon predictions inherit period uncertainty (σ up to ~3 u0 at t≈530 d), inherent to the 208-d observed baseline.
